result.topic_en: A faint pencil remark that the following derivation of the general laws of vortex motion departs from the Lagrangian description of motion, plus a small block of upside-down calculations in the lower right corner.

$\frac{\partial v}{\sqrt{1-v^2}}\, M - M'$ [?]

methods.what: Change of variable expressing a differential in terms of a function M evaluated at 1+v and 1-v, reducing to a form with square root of 1-v^2
